title: Classic Outlook data files
whyItMatters: Outlook keeps offline copies of mail, calendar and contacts in OST files. A new owner could read correspondence the person thought was only online.
source: Microsoft Support, Create an Outlook Data File: offline .ost files are saved under drive:/Users/user/AppData/Local/Microsoft/Outlook - https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/outlook/create-an-outlook-data-file-pst-to-save-your-information
notes: OST files are server caches; PST archives are usually under Documents/Outlook Files and are not matched here. No mail file is opened or indexed.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Outlook, use File > Open & Export > Import/Export to save mail, contacts and calendar to a .pst file you keep.
cleanup.signOut: In Outlook, remove the account in Account Settings so the profile no longer signs in on this PC.
steps: Remove the email account or profile the way the vendor page describes.
Delete the Outlook folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes the offline copy of mail, calendar and contacts for this profile; anything not exported and not on the server is gone.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Remove or delete an email account from classic Outlook for Windows: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/outlook/remove-or-delete-an-email-account-from-classic-outlook-for-windows
